name: TimeRange
note: APPROVED: store UTC; client displays in its local timezone; start < end. Half-open interval permits adjacent bookings. Exact wire format remains proposed.

name: BookingRequest
note: APPROVED scope: ID is an idempotency key; identical retry returns the prior result without duplicate booking. APPROVED scope: different payload with same ID is rejected; exact wire status remains open.

name: BookingCreateResult
note: Technical result: created=true only for newly committed booking; false for identical prior request. Enables proposed 201/200 distinction without re-query/race. Wire status mapping remains proposed.

name: SqliteConfiguration
note: Booking and incident paths must be distinct. No credentials. Journal/durability settings are fixed by reviewed schema policy, not an arbitrary SQL string.

name: HttpServerConfiguration
note: Local prototype binds 127.0.0.1; no security claim for later Oracle deployment.

name: BookingRepository
methods: virtual Result<BookingCreateResult> createIfAvailable(const BookingRequest& request, UtcTime now) = 0;
note: APPROVED: one write transaction checks overlaps, deduplicates and persists request ID/result with unique ID; explicit rollback on failure. Same ID with different data is rejected. Concurrent/crash tests required. Journal/synchronous policy remains open. No disable-guard/cancel/repair API in first milestone.

name: SqliteBookingRepository
methods: Result<BookingCreateResult> createIfAvailable(const BookingRequest& request, UtcTime now) override;
note: Open existing/initialize new only in explicit setup mode documented by composition; schema migration failure aborts. Repository reports errors; no exception hidden as success.

name: BookingService
methods: static bool overlaps(const TimeRange& first, const TimeRange& second);

name: BookingHttpServer
note: Owns external httplib server; run blocks only backend main thread. APPROVED booking scope: list rooms, list bookings and create booking. APPROVED routes: GET /api/rooms, GET /api/bookings, POST /api/bookings. JSON schema, UTC wire representation and HTTP status mapping remain proposed. No dependency on Rivive Shield.

name: TargetConfiguration
note: One operator-reviewed local target, fixed executable/arguments; no shell, no caller PID, no remote execution. Paths validated at setup.

name: ProcessIdentity
note: PID is descriptive, not a mutation authority. Windows authority is retained HANDLE; Mac authority is exclusive unreaped child relationship.

name: ProcessObservation
note: Exit code alone never classifies user intent or crash cause.

name: CaptureConfiguration
note: All values positive and reviewed; no invented numeric production defaults. Only loopback IPv4 and port; failure/limit marks uncertainty.

name: ConnectionSnapshot
note: SnapshotCandidate means match NOW, not packet-time ownership. None/Unknown never authorize repair.

name: HttpObservation
note: No URI/body/header values. Incomplete/unsupported is not success; HTTP status and complete transport are independent.

name: DatabaseCheck
note: Read-only open without CREATE; preserve sidecars. Busy/missing/invalid/unknown never PASS. Not business invariants or forensic immutability.

name: Evidence
note: Immutable accepted metadata; no raw packet or request payload in stored evidence.

name: PacketView
note: Borrowed memory valid only during callback; decoder must not retain pointer.

name: StreamChunk
note: Temporary bytes owned by reassembler; missing marker is never fed to HTTP parser. connectionClosed does not infer application cause.

name: OwnedDemoProcess
methods: virtual Status requestGracefulStop(const ProcessIdentity& expected, Deadline deadline) = 0;
virtual Status forceStop(const ProcessIdentity& expected, Deadline deadline) = 0;
note: Only controller-created fixed target; graceful stop is platform capability, Unsupported is valid. Do not terminate/reopen arbitrary PID.

name: WindowsOwnedDemoProcess
methods: Status requestGracefulStop(const ProcessIdentity& expected, Deadline deadline) override;
Status forceStop(const ProcessIdentity& expected, Deadline deadline) override;
note: Serialized owner thread. Destructor releases handles/resources but never silently forces termination. Mac implementation/permissions pending actual test.

name: MacOwnedDemoProcess
methods: Status requestGracefulStop(const ProcessIdentity& expected, Deadline deadline) override;
Status forceStop(const ProcessIdentity& expected, Deadline deadline) override;
note: Serialized owner thread. Destructor releases handles/resources but never silently forces termination. Mac implementation/permissions pending actual test.

name: ConnectionObserver
methods: virtual Result<ConnectionSnapshot> snapshot(const FlowKey& flow, const ProcessIdentity& expected) const = 0;

name: WindowsConnectionObserver
methods: Result<ConnectionSnapshot> snapshot(const FlowKey& flow, const ProcessIdentity& expected) const override;
note: Mac may return Unsupported/Unknown until implementation verified. Windows snapshot cannot prove packet-time attribution.

name: MacConnectionObserver
methods: Result<ConnectionSnapshot> snapshot(const FlowKey& flow, const ProcessIdentity& expected) const override;
note: Mac may return Unsupported/Unknown until implementation verified. Windows snapshot cannot prove packet-time attribution.

name: PacketCapture
methods: virtual Result<std::size_t> readBatch(std::size_t maxPackets, const PacketSink& sink, Deadline deadline) = 0;

name: PcapLoopbackCapture
methods: Result<std::size_t> readBatch(std::size_t maxPackets, const PacketSink& sink, Deadline deadline) override;
note: External pcap state; Npcap Windows / libpcap Mac. No silent permissions elevation. Filter and link type verified before read.

name: TcpStreamDecoder
note: Wrap PCPP callback; bytesMissing/overflow/midstream forces uncertain flow. close/reset release buffers; never network sockets. Conservative accepted-byte budget is enforced before reassembly; rotation/reset never turns incomplete data into complete evidence.

name: HttpFlowState
note: Parser pointers are external llhttp state. No application body accumulation. One pending request per flow; later keep-alive is serial.

name: HttpSessionTracker
methods: HttpSessionTracker(CaptureConfiguration configuration, HttpSink sink, Now now);
note: GET/POST HTTP1.1 serial only; unsupported 1xx/upgrade/pipeline marked unknown, not silently skipped. Timing is observation duration, not internal execution. Parser callbacks must map to listed helpers. Stable list node addresses back llhttp.data; never move nodes. Free both parsers before erasing a node; callbacks are synchronous on owner thread and cannot survive erase/reset.

name: Monitor
methods: Monitor(PacketCapture& capture, TcpStreamDecoder& tcp, HttpSessionTracker& http, OwnedDemoProcess& process, const ConnectionObserver& connections, EvidenceSink sink, Now now);
note: Passive observation; no automatic HTTP health/booking requests. Absence of traffic is not health. OS process checks are separate from network polling.

name: RepairPlan
note: Immutable exact action/target revision. Proposed actions only StartStoppedOwnedTarget or ForceStopOwnedTarget. Force stop is a separate displayed/approved plan; never inferred approval.

name: DiagnosisResult
note: HTTP-only symptoms/unknown ownership may produce no plan. No inference of cause from status alone.

name: ExecutionResult
note: Maybe-invoked failure is Uncertain; no automatic retry.

name: VerificationBatch
note: Functional confirmation comes from a separately labeled operator-driven synthetic test; no automatic modifying booking probe. NotRun blocks Recovered.

name: ControlEvent
note: Technical typed control event, never a magic Error. BeginDiagnosis/PlanInvalidated carry no plan; ManualStopProposal carries a proposed ForceStop plan bound to selected owned target. It is not approval or dispatch authority.

name: IncidentEvent
fields: std::variant<Evidence, DiagnosisResult, Approval, ExecutionResult, VerificationBatch, ControlEvent, Error> payload;

name: OperatorView
note: Bounded metadata only; durable=false conspicuous; never show unsaved recovery.

name: IncidentRepository
methods: virtual Result<SaveReceipt> save(const IncidentRecord& record, Version expectedRecordVersion) = 0;
virtual Result<IncidentRecord> load(const IncidentId& id) const = 0;
virtual Result<DispatchReceipt> claimDispatch(const IncidentId& id, const AttemptId& attempt, Version expectedRecordVersion, UtcTime now) = 0;
virtual Result<std::vector<IncidentRecord>> history(std::size_t offset, std::size_t limit) const = 0;

name: SqliteIncidentRepository
methods: Result<SaveReceipt> save(const IncidentRecord& record, Version expectedRecordVersion) override;
Result<IncidentRecord> load(const IncidentId& id) const override;
Result<DispatchReceipt> claimDispatch(const IncidentId& id, const AttemptId& attempt, Version expectedRecordVersion, UtcTime now) override;
Result<std::vector<IncidentRecord>> history(std::size_t offset, std::size_t limit) const override;

name: DatabaseVerifier
methods: Result<DatabaseCheck> check(const std::string& databasePath, const ProcessObservation& stoppedProcess, Deadline deadline) const;
note: Verify expected local configured DB and writers stopped; no CREATE; no repair SQL; no sidecar deletion. Other possible writers => Inconclusive.

name: PlanPolicy
methods: Status validate(const RepairPlan& plan, const Incident& incident, UtcTime now) const;
Status revalidate(const RepairPlan& plan, const Approval& approval, const Incident& incident, const ProcessObservation& current, UtcTime now) const;

name: DiagnosticAgent
methods: Result<DiagnosisResult> propose(const Incident& incident, const PlanId& newPlanId, Version newPlanRevision, UtcTime expiresAt) const;
private: DiagnosisResult evaluateCompiledRules(const Incident& incident, const PlanId& planId, Version revision, UtcTime expiresAt) const;
note: Compiled-in versioned rules only. Unknown cause/ownership cannot become destructive authorization.

name: RepairExecutor
methods: RepairExecutor(OwnedDemoProcess& target, IncidentRepository& repository, const PlanPolicy& policy, Now now);
Result<ExecutionResult> executeOnce(const PlanId& planId, const ApprovalId& approvalId, const AttemptId& attemptId, const IncidentId& incidentId, Deadline deadline);
note: Reload authoritative exact record; validate; durable CAS claim; invoke allowlisted action once. No automatic replay after uncertain result or restart.

name: RecoveryVerifier
methods: RecoveryVerifier(OwnedDemoProcess& target, const DatabaseVerifier& database, TargetConfiguration configuration, Now now);

Result<VerificationBatch> verify(const RepairPlan& approvedPlan, const RepairAttempt& attempt, const ExecutionResult& execution, const DatabaseCheck& priorStoppedCheck, const std::vector<Evidence>& laterEvidence, Deadline deadline) const;
note: Stop is not recovery. For start, valid prior stopped DB check + new process + independent later functional evidence required; no requests replayed.

name: IncidentStateMachine
methods: Result<Transition> apply(const IncidentRecord& current, const IncidentEvent& event) const;
note: APPROVED state names: Detected, Diagnosing, AwaitingApproval, Executing, Verifying, Recovered, NeedsReview, Declined, Unresolved. No closing an incident with unresolved side effects. Exact transition rules remain under review. Pure function; no persistence, process or network side effects.

name: IncidentOrchestrator
methods: IncidentOrchestrator(IncidentRepository& repository, DiagnosticAgent& diagnosis, RepairExecutor& executor, RecoveryVerifier& verifier, const IncidentStateMachine& stateMachine, Now now, std::size_t queueCapacity);
void publishSettingsResult(bool pending, bool saved, std::optional<Error> error);
Status proposeManualStop(const IncidentId& incidentId, const ProcessIdentity& expected, const PlanId& planId, UtcTime expiresAt);
note: APPROVED scope: one active incident per configured target, aggregate observations, no concurrent actions, and no old approval reused for a new incident. Single background owner; callbacks enqueue only. No lock across I/O. Store failure blocks actions. Old dispatch remains NeedsReview after controller restart. requestHistory validates bounded page size and enqueues under queueMutex_. processPending loads history on owner thread and publishes immutable page under viewMutex_; GUI never calls repository. publishSettingsResult is owner-thread only. view() reads only publishedView_ under viewMutex_, never storage/current_ from UI. Publish a value-copy after commit or visible failure. Manual stop proposal is not approval. It requires a subsequent exact plan decision; diagnostics cannot create force-stop authority from HTTP-only evidence.

name: LocalSettingsRepository
note: Local bounded config, atomic replacement; no credentials; no arbitrary commands.

name: DesktopView
note: UI thread boundary, wxWidgets external scheduler; no state transitions in view.

name: WxDesktopView
note: External wx object tree owns widgets. Constructor/destructor and event bindings UI-thread only; widget IDs/layout are not business contracts. Callback binding requires exact reviewed composition.

name: DesktopPresenter
methods: DesktopPresenter(DesktopView& view, IncidentOrchestrator& core, ControllerRuntime& runtime);
note: No waiting on I/O in GUI event handlers; settings change forbidden while target/incident active. Settings apply next explicit setup session. saveSettings delegates only to runtime.requestSettingsSave; returned Status means queued, not persisted. requestHistory delegates to core queue.

name: ControllerRuntime
methods: ControllerRuntime(Monitor& monitor, IncidentOrchestrator& core, OwnedDemoProcess& process, DesktopView& view, SettingsRepository& settings);
note: Settings saves are queued with bounded capacity, processed only by owner thread after stopped/no-active-incident gate, then published through core.publishSettingsResult. No settings I/O in GUI. One background control thread; bounded tick; join before releasing dependencies. requestInitialStart queues only. Owner thread checks core.mayStartForSetup(), no pending durable incidents and current NotStarted/Exited before fixed process start. No start bypass during incident. Window close does not silently kill booking.
